A1.justification: Both PDFs present the same DGS-Net study, with readable text, equations, three figures, nine tables, and complete corresponding appendices. Benchmark relabeling and appendix renumbering can be matched reliably.

before.justification: v1 reports original detection experiments, component ablations, robustness tests, and supplementary benchmark results in Tables 1–9.

after.justification: v2 retains original benchmark, ablation, and robustness outcomes, including the UniversalFakeDetect and AIGIBench appendix results.

M1.justification: The CLIP/LoRA architecture, BLIP captions, frozen teacher, orthogonal suppression, prior alignment, training objective, and inference procedure remain unchanged in Section 4 and Equations 5–17. Revised motivation does not establish a procedural change.

E1.justification: Training coverage and the evaluated generators and perturbation scenarios are retained. The benchmark called GenImage in v1 becomes AIGCDetectBench in v2, with matching generator columns and results; this is relabeling and reattribution, not evidence of changed coverage. The new ImageNet mention supplies background motivation rather than an experiment.

E2.justification: The same eleven baseline detectors participate in the benchmark comparisons, and the same six participate in Tables 5–6 robustness comparisons. The C2P-CLIP adaptation replacing ClipCap with BLIP is retained.

E3.justification: Both report Setting-II training with 144k images, CLIP ViT-L/14, Adam at learning rate 0.0001, batch size 32, one epoch, and 224×224 patch selection. Metrics and JPEG/blur strengths also match. Omitted implementation settings do not establish a changed protocol.

E4.justification: The component ablations in Table 4, gradient-component experiments in Table 9, JPEG/blur robustness tests in Tables 5–6, and feature/text analyses in Figures 1 and 3 are retained. Appendix Sections 7–10 correspond to Appendices A–D.

E5.justification: Neither version reports repeated-run or seed counts, confidence intervals, standard deviations, or significance tests. The reporting practice remains point estimates and benchmark averages.

E6.justification: Table 3 revises DFFreq's real-image accuracy from 99.3% to 91.8%, ProGAN accuracy from 78.4% to 99.3%, and average from 58.8% to 59.3%. Other numerical table entries and plotted results match, including all DGS-Net scores.

T1.justification: Equations 1–17 retain the same mathematical definitions, directional reasoning, orthogonal projection derivation, alignment gradient, and parameter update. No new proof or mathematical correction accompanies the explanatory revisions.

C1.justification: The abstract, introduction, and conclusion retain the claims about diagnosing catastrophic forgetting, combining suppression with prior preservation, and achieving a 6.6% average improvement across 50 generative models. The new Impact Statement reiterates the existing societal motivation.

C2.justification: Section 4.2 shifts the mechanism explanation from dataset-specific semantic shortcuts to potentially harmful update directions associated with detection errors, and softens assertions about semantic interference. The limitations concerning DALLE-3, SocialRF, CommunityAI, and unknown post-processing remain.

D1.justification: Section 5.1 removes the PyTorch and NVIDIA RTX 4090 disclosures and the explicit settings lora_r=6, lora_alpha=6, and lora_dropout=0.8. These details are not relocated to the appendices. This reduces implementation documentation without establishing that the implementation changed.

R1.justification: The GenImage reference is replaced by Zhong et al.'s Patchcraft reference when identifying AIGCDetectBench. Several references, including FakeInversion, D3, and SemGIR, disappear, and Section 2.1 trims method descriptions. The broader CLIP adaptation and distillation positioning remains stable.

P1.justification: v2 makes limited cuts and rewrites in the introduction, related work, and experiments; adds Ziwen He to the authors and an Impact Statement; switches to author–year citations; and renumbers supplementary sections as Appendices A–D. The main narrative and section sequence remain.

P2.justification: v2 substantially reformats the document with a redesigned title/author block, ruled running headers, captions above tables, resized table columns, relocated Figure 3 and robustness tables, and single-column appendices replacing the two-column supplement. All three figure graphics and nine tables are retained.

improvement.justification: The more qualified explanation in Section 4.2 offers a modest clarity benefit, but v2 removes explicit LoRA hyperparameters and execution-environment information from Section 5.1 without restoring them in the appendices. This concretely reduces reproducibility. The benchmark reattribution, limited baseline-score updates, and redesigned presentation do not outweigh that loss; the principal scientific support remains unchanged.
